tha-ap186:1.1: samattaṃ. [184. Pañcahatthiya.] Tisso nāmāsi bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / purakkhato sāvakehi rathiyaṃ paṭipajjatha. // //
tha-ap186:2.1: Pañcauppalahatthā ca catur' oṭṭhapitā mayā / āhutiṃ dātukāmo 'haṃ mūgo 'mhi vata siddhiyā. // //
tha-ap186:3.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantam antarāpaṇe / Buddharaṃsābhighuṭṭho 'mhi pūjesiṃ dipaduttamaṃ // //
tha-ap186:4.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap186:5.1: Ito terasakappamhi pañc' āsu Sabhāsammatā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap186:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pañcahatthiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
